subject: Next step: private/VPC architecture alignment session for OptixHealth
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@optixhealth.com>, Maya Li <maya.li@optixhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next step: private/VPC architecture alignment session for OptixHealth

Hi Sam / Maya —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: deploy Redwood Private into OptixHealth's VPC with strict network controls and KMS integration.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent compliance needs, 3rd-party HSM for key management, and a segmented subnet topology (ingest/serving/management).

Per our notes, the best next step is a short architecture alignment session (30–45m) where Soojin (solutions engineer) and I walk through the proposed topology and collect any network/contact points your infra team will need. Ideally we can get your DevOps folks on the call so we can agree on IP allowlists, peering/VPN options, and any on-prem requirements.

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- Wed 17 Jun, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu 18 Jun, 11:00–11:45 PT

If neither works, send two slots that do and we’ll accommodate. Attaching a one-page agenda and a short checklist of documents we’ll ask your infra team to have handy (network diagram, KMS contact, sample retention policy).

Agenda highlights (attached):
- 10m: intro & success criteria
- 15m: proposed VPC topology + routing options (peering vs transit gateway)
- 10m: security controls (KMS, audit logs, data flows)
- 5–10m: action items + next steps (pilot timeline)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Optix-Private-Deploy-Checklist.pdf, redwood-arch-deepdive-agenda.md

From: Sam Park <sam.park@optixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Maya Li <maya.li@optixhealth.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <infra@optixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next step: private/VPC architecture alignment session for OptixHealth

Ben — thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. Both look good.

We can do Wed 17 Jun at 09:00 PT. I’m looping in our lead infra contact (infra@optixhealth.com) — that’s a shared inbox for the on-call infra engineers; Jorge will join from that alias.

Two quick clarifications before we lock the invite:
1) Will this session cover the on-prem connector? We may need to validate a physical appliance footprint if we go hybrid for the audit logs.
2) For KMS, we use HashiCorp Vault + an HSM gateway. Should we have our Vault admin (cc'd Jorge when he joins) available?

If those two people are useful, we’ll try to get them on the call.

Sam
VP Product, OptixHealth
sam.park@optixhealth.com | +1 (206) 555-8721

Thanks Sam — yes, we can cover on-prem connector considerations in the same session.

Quick note on attendees that makes the call productive:
- Your Vault/HSM admin (to confirm key rotation and PKCS#11/GCP/Azure HSM options)
- A network engineer who can speak to subnets, NAT/egress and whether an Appliance (if used) needs a dedicated rack/colo presence

If your infra team can't get their Vault admin on the first pass, no problem — we’ll capture the questions and follow up with a 20m deep-dive later. During the alignment session we’ll focus on network design and high-level integration points so we have clear action items for the Vault/HSM follow-up.

I added a short pre-read (attached) with the specific ports and IP ranges we’ll discuss — if the infra team can open those temporarily for the call it speeds things up.
